name: UCLA-3
source: Hughes, Waite, Hawkley & Cacioppo (2004), 'A Short Scale for Measuring Loneliness in Large Surveys', derived from the R-UCLA Loneliness Scale (Russell, 1996). Free to use.
note: PROVISIONAL until clinician sign-off: the published scale is dichotomous (3-5 not lonely, 6-9 lonely) and that split is preserved here. The band-to-severity mapping is Reitti's, and is deliberately conservative — 'lonely' contributes severity 1, enough to supply the social domain tag that modifier M5 needs to prefer a group, but never enough to raise the ladder on its own or to open the deeper screeners.
